_about: Decision 4 (reminders, Siri, Live Activity and alarms while App Lock is on), 9 Oct 2026. scan_notif.py found 2,854 reviews with a notification/Siri/Lock Screen word near a privacy word plus 49 about generic or custom reminder text; a tighter privacy pass left 265, all read by hand; plus the first read's LEAK_NOTIF, LEAK_OTHER, WANTS_VISIBLE and DISCREET codes. Most of the 265 are 'embarrassing sound', 'personal secretary', 'time-sensitive' or billing reviews (not relevant). Codes: PRIVATE_WANT (wants reminders/Siri not to reveal a habit), DISCREET_PRAISE (praises 'discreet' reminders: often means unobtrusive, not private), GENERIC_BAD (a reminder that doesn't say what it's for is ignored or useless), CUSTOM_TEXT_PRAISE / CUSTOM_TEXT_WANT (the person's own reminder words), LOCKSCREEN_ACTION (values acting on a reminder without opening the app).
